Title: Ick, A Bod
Writer: Erica Larson, Matthew K. Begbie, Anju Andre-Bergmann
Actors: Carrie Preston, Wendell Pierce, Sullivan Jones
Plot: Elsbeth must separate trick from treat when a rivalry reaches a ghoulish climax on Halloween night after a suburban homemaker butts heads with a new neighbor; Captain Wagner makes a frightening discovery about his daughter.
